g.text: Accepted native dynamics and independently checked energy ledger
Wload + Wdrag + Wnumeric + Wwall,damp = ΔU + ΔK + D + ΔUc + ΔUw − Jc + R
D is the actual irreversible variational energy release. R is retained separately; rejected candidates are excluded.
